planBudget.title: Plan & budget
planBudget.subtitle: Used to compute API-equivalent value and the burn-rate forecast on Insights.
planBudget.monthlyPlanPriceHint: What you actually pay — used for the "value vs plan" comparison.
planBudget.monthlyBudgetHint: Drives the budget bar and forecast warning on Insights.
planBudget.contextAlertThresholdHint: Notify when a session's context high-water mark crosses this share of its model's window.
planBudget.invalidNumber: Enter a number of 0 or more.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.contextAlertsHint: OS notification + in-app banner when a session crosses the threshold above.
notifications.dailyDigestHint: A quiet, once-a-day summary — no push during active work.
notifications.budgetWarningsHint: Notify at 80% and 100% of the monthly budget above.

logsDirectory.title: Logs directory
logsDirectory.subtitle: Arlo reads Claude Code transcripts from this path — nothing leaves your machine.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Read-only. Rates are keyed to when each request happened, not the rate in effect today.
pricing.footerNote: Rates are per million tokens ($/Mtok) as published by Anthropic. Cache write 1h is charged at the same rate as cache write 5m. Actual costs may vary; check anthropic.com/pricing for the latest rates.
pricing.unpricedWarning: Pricing not found for {models}. Cost estimates may be inaccurate.
